notes.origin: The Gull Skerries (task A3b, the island group's third map: the south tip, its two islets and the west cliff strip) share Landfall's ground, kit and sea: this file is sw_isle.json's palette, measured there in the client survey (game-look fix stage), as The Tollholms' is, so the three maps meet without a seam in colour.
notes.grade: None: a continent region (its manifest has continentGeography), so a grade section would be ignored (look_profile.gd map_trim). Sky and fog come from the manifest, Crownwater's lagoon as on sw_isle; sky.haze_warmth 0.1 as there.
notes.ground: As sw_isle: the plateau's meadow at meadow_value 0.76 and tint [0.72, 1, 0.6]; the opaque Meshy base as a BIOME verge with all of the detail tile's grain (verge_grain 1), calmer on the south tip's and the skerries' cliffs (verge_grain_steep 0.3); the coastal gravel patches over the cliffs as solid rock at rock_value 0.32. The map has no road and no paving; their keys are sw_isle's, so a path drawn here later matches the isle's.
notes.grass: As sw_isle: grass follows the base's green (open_green 1), so the beaches, the cliffs and the fin talus grow none.
notes.foliage: As sw_isle: the same kit trees and shrubs (a3b/dress.py's census is sw_isle's species mix).
notes.props: None of its own: the map has no landmark building, so no prop keeps its chroma or a hole round the player.
notes.water: The same continent-sea decode as sw_isle (sea_value 8.5, sea_chroma 1.25, sea_tint [0.55, 1, 1.05]): the two maps' seas meet along z 8259 and x 399, and any other value would draw a step in the sea's colour along the seam.
